_comment: Which script produces which dataset, and what it needs to run.
Every dataset in this repo was built by a script that nobody recorded, from
an input nobody kept. That is why six audit findings sit OPEN: the fix is
known, the file it needs is not on disk, and there was no way to tell which
script would consume it or where to put it. This manifest is that record.
inputs  — files the build needs before it can run, relative to the repo root
network — true when the script fetches from the source itself
env     — environment variables the script needs
source  — the key in src/data/sources.js that documents where to get it

votes.note: Scrapes votaciones.hcdn.gob.ar and senado.gob.ar. Vote ids are hard-coded in the script; add new ones there before re-running.

news.note: The shipped snapshot is from 2026-04-01. Re-running replaces it.

oilgas.note: ~989k rows of well-level production. Not in the repo: too large to commit.

energy-overlays.note: Downloads the four datos.energia.gob.ar CSVs itself. Always run the postprocess step: it rounds coordinates and canonicalises province names. Skipping it triples the size of yacimientos.json.

censo-empleo.note: Reads INDEC's censo2022_caracteristicas_economicas.pdf, cuadro 4.1. The PDF is not in the repo; sources.js has the URL.

censo-categoria.note: Reads INDEC's censo2022_caracteristicas_economicas.pdf, cuadro 4.2. The PDF is not in the repo; sources.js has the URL.

dnap-empleo.note: Reads the DNAP xlsx directly (Administración Central + Organismos Descentralizados + Cuentas Especiales, cargos ocupados al 31/12). A build_dnap_empleo.mjs used to write the same file from ratios transcribed by hand off the 2024 chart; it was deleted because it silently overwrote the xlsx figures — including the salary columns, which it never had — with rounded approximations.

sipa-pub-priv.note: Dataset discontinued November 2023; these files will not get newer.

provincial-economy.note: Orchestrates process_sipa and the DNAP fiscal build; both download their own raw files.

provenance.note: Idempotent. Run after any build that writes a new dataset file.

geojson.note: Simplifies the raw energy GeoJSON down to what the map can load (ductos 99 MB, gasoductos 9.7 MB). It also has branches writing ductos.json, lineas_electricas.json and produccion.json, none of which are in the repo — those layers were dropped and the code was left behind. gasoductos.json is the one output nothing else produces. It can also overwrite yacimientos.json, which update-energy-overlays.mjs builds from the CSV API: prefer that pipeline for yacimientos and run this one only for the pipeline layers.
